summary: Verified the framer-motion v11 -> v12.42.2 upgrade fix for the React 19 production-build crash on the deployed (production build) preview URL. Executed the exact failure mode from before: full page.goto hard-loads for all 12 routes, plus 3x hard reloads of /recreational and / (the reported crashing routes). The ErrorBoundary recovery UI (data-testid='error-reload-btn') did NOT appear on any route or any reload. Home hero renders correctly (parallax useScroll) with 'FLIP. FLY. FIND YOUR GREATNESS.' text and stat counters using useInView populated ('22+', '140+', '30+'). Client-side navigation via header direct links and both Programs/Events Radix dropdowns to all sub-routes also passed with zero ErrorBoundary triggers and zero pageerror events. Fix confirmed working.
critical_code_review_comments: framer-motion is now 12.42.2 in /app/frontend/package.json (React 19 native support). useScroll in Home.jsx and useInView in StatCounter.jsx both use {layoutEffect:false} which is the correct SSR/React-19-safe pattern.

Header does not link to /calendar directly (only HOME/ABOUT/PROGRAMS/EVENTS/CONTACT are in the top-level nav). /calendar is reachable via direct URL and its page renders fine — this matches the review-request note that the calendar link may not be in header nav. Not a bug.
Console noise is only 401s on GET /api/auth/me while logged out — expected per review request.
No pageerror events across 12 hard-loads + 6 reloads + 11 client-side navigations = 29 total transitions.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — 29/29 route transitions render without ErrorBoundary, 0 pageerrors, 0 non-401 console errors

test_credentials: Not used - review request scope did not require auth. admin@usgoldgym.com / GymAdmin2026! is documented per /app/memory/test_credentials.md if needed later.
context_for_next_testing_agent: framer-motion v12.42.2 fix for React 19 production build is verified end-to-end on the production build serving at REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Hard-load and reload of /recreational and / (previously crashing routes) both render cleanly. The ErrorBoundary safety net (data-testid='error-reload-btn') never fires. Home page's useScroll parallax and StatCounter's useInView both animate correctly. If future crashes are reported, check that layoutEffect:false is still present on any new framer-motion useScroll/useInView call sites in components rendered above the fold, and confirm framer-motion version has not been downgraded.
rca of the issue: PRIOR bug: framer-motion v11 was incompatible with React 19 production builds because React 19 removed the dev-only double render — so hooks like useScroll/useInView received an undefined ref on first paint and threw, which the ErrorBoundary caught as the 'OOPS' screen. Reproduced only in production bundles, not in dev. FIX (applied by main agent, now verified): (1) upgrade framer-motion to 12.42.2 (native React 19 support), (2) pass {layoutEffect:false} to useScroll in Home.jsx and useInView in StatCounter.jsx so the effects run synchronously with the ref attachment path used by React 19. Verification here executed the exact production artifact via hard page.goto on the preview URL that serves the yarn build output — the crash did not reproduce on any of 12 routes or on 3x repeated reloads of the two previously-failing routes.
